system.description:
You gather your cursed vitae upon your tongue and spit it forth like a serpent's venom, and where the black spray strikes, flesh sears, blisters and blackens.

You may spit a Trait's worth of blood at your foes, doing aggravated damage to those you hit. An attack of this form is considered a ranged attack; therefore you may use your Mental Traits to defend against your target's Physical Traits. You may spit blood ten feet for every two Physical Traits you possess.
